positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
◦ Led a team of 10+ engineers in designing and implementing a comprehensive user management service using Java and Spring, maintaining all user data for the company, enhancing data integrity and security.
 ◦ Mentored junior developers through code reviews and pair programming sessions, contributing to increased team productivity.
 ◦ Designed and implemented a new Java microservice as the authoritative source of place data, which improved accuracy of distance and pricing calculations by 20% and reduced errors by 50%.
 ◦ Developed a front-end application in React for the places service, allowing internal users to efficiently interact with and manage places-related information.
 ◦ Integrated multiple microservices with Auth0, streamlining authentication and authorization processes, and improving overall security and user management resulting in a 40% reduction in unauthorized access incidents.
 ◦ Designed and implemented dashboards in Datadog to monitor the health and performance of multiple microservices, providing real-time insights into system behavior and resource utilization.
 ◦ Enforced code quality standards making sure we hit >60% code coverage in Sonar and reviewed >80% of PRs for responsible project repos
 ◦ Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions on time and within budget

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
◦ Developed a document management service using Node.js integrated with Amazon S3, handling all document functions within the company, including storage, retrieval, and management.
 ◦ Created a Java microservice for maintaining carrier data, ensuring data consistency across systems and reducing data discrepancies.
 ◦ Developed Node.js scripts for seamless data migration from MySQL to PostgreSQL databases, achieving 100% data integrity post-migration.
 ◦ Integrated the mobile application with third-party services to validate user-provided data, improving carrier approval rates by 30%.
 ◦ Developed a front-end application in React for the carrier service, allowing internal users to efficiently interact with and manage carrier-related information.
 ◦ Configured alerts in Datadog to proactively identify and address issues, ensuring high availability and reliability of services.

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
• Provide help with the daily operation of the office, address customer questions, requests and concerns in person, via phone and electronically, troubleshoot and utilize critical thinking to resolve a variety of situations
• Provide excellent customer service while expanding a growing eSports community, welcoming those interested in joining the eSports community

positions.title: Academic Intern
positions.description:
• Assist peers during lab hours with various assignments and projects and provide support via an online forum
• Provide tutoring during office hours, facilitate test preparation sessions, and review concepts taught in class
